messages.subject: rstudio::conf(2020) Davis Meetup
parts:
To all Davis R-Users Group, UC Davis DataLab (aka Data Science Initiative) Affiliates, Alumni and Friends,


We are organizing a UC Davis drop-in Birds of a Feather breakfast meetup at the RStudio::conf(2020) in San Francisco this THURSDAY (January 30th) from 8am-9am. Meet in the Golden Gate room and come find us in the tables to the far back left of the dining hall (there will be some smaller signage). Come catch up, make new connections and chat about all things Davis, R, research and beyond! (Because breakfast is part of the conference, it’s limited to conference participants.)


We hope to see you there!


Davis R-Users Group & DataLab
